name: jsci

on:
  pull_request:
  pull_request_target:
    types:
      - labeled
  push:
    branches:
      - main

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  fmt:
    # Primus needs org secrets, which pull_request withholds from forks and dependabot.
    # A maintainer adds the safe-to-test label to run it on those through pull_request_target.
    if: &primus-gate |
      github.event_name == 'push' ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && ! github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork && github.event.pull_request.user.login != 'dependabot[bot]' && ! contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'safe-to-test')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && github.event.label.name == 'safe-to-test')
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    uses: signoz/primus.workflows/.github/workflows/js-fmt.yaml@main
    secrets: inherit
    with: &primus-inputs
      PRIMUS_REF: main
      NODE_VERSION: "24"
      JS_SRC: .
      JS_PKG_MANAGER: pnpm
      # Same as devEngines.packageManager in package.json. Primus runs setup-node before
      # pnpm, and setup-node fails to find pnpm when package.json has a packageManager field.
      PNPM_VERSION: 10.30.3
  lint:
    if: *primus-gate
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    uses: signoz/primus.workflows/.github/workflows/js-lint.yaml@main
    secrets: inherit
    with: *primus-inputs
  type-check:
    if: *primus-gate
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    uses: signoz/primus.workflows/.github/workflows/js-type-check.yaml@main
    secrets: inherit
    with: *primus-inputs
  test:
    # Needs no secrets, so it runs on pull_request for every PR and skips the labeled rerun.
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request_target'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Both suites run in Chromium. Keep the tag in sync with playwright in pnpm-lock.yaml.
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.61.0-noble
    steps:
      # inspired by https://mathio28.medium.com/squeezing-disk-space-from-github-actions-runners-an-engineers-guide-d5fbe4443692
      # to fix the issue with the runner running out of space
      - name: aggressive-cleanup
        run: |
          # Remove Java (JDKs)
          rm -rf /usr/lib/jvm

          # Remove .NET SDKs
          rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet

          # Remove Swift toolchain
          rm -rf /usr/share/swift

          # Remove Haskell (GHC)
          rm -rf /usr/local/.ghcup

          # Remove Julia
          rm -rf /usr/local/julia*

          # Remove Android SDKs
          rm -rf /usr/local/lib/android

          # Remove Microsoft/Edge and Google Chrome builds
          rm -rf /opt/microsoft /opt/google

          # Remove Azure CLI
          rm -rf /opt/az

          # Remove PowerShell
          rm -rf /usr/local/share/powershell

          # Remove CodeQL and other toolcaches
          rm -rf /opt/hostedtoolcache

          df -h
      - name: self-checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: install-pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: node-install
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: pnpm
      - name: install
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: test
        run: pnpm test
  build:
    # Needs no secrets, so it runs on pull_request for every PR and skips the labeled rerun.
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request_target'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: self-checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: install-pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@ea17c68df8912ef543352723c149a84f56e3d413 # v6.1.0
      - name: node-install
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: pnpm
      - name: install
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: build
        run: pnpm build

{
	"name": "docs",
	"version": "0.1.21",
	"private": true,
	"type": "module",
	"scripts": {
		"dev": "storybook dev -p 6006",
		"build": "storybook build --docs",
		"preview-storybook": "serve storybook-static",
		"build-storybook": "storybook build -o storybook-static",
		"clean": "rm -rf .turbo && rm -rf node_modules",
		"chromatic": "pnpm dlx chromatic --exit-zero-on-changes  --config-file 'chromatic.config.json'",
		"test": "VITEST_CHROMIUM_GC_DISK_THRESHOLD_GB=100000 vitest run",
		"type-check": "tsgo --noEmit"
	},

		"playwright": "^1.61.0",
		"react-syntax-highlighter": "^16.1.1",
		"remark-gfm": "^4.0.1",
		"serve": "^14.2.1",
		"storybook": "^10.6.1",
		"storybook-addon-pseudo-states": "~10.6.1",
		"vite": "8.3.3",
		"vitest": "^5.0.3"
	}
}
